other_failure_modes.name: Non-differentiable objective in gradient-based optimization
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses SLSQP (a gradient-based optimizer) to minimize a discrete step function (accuracy_score). Gradient-based optimizers rely on numerical gradients, which are zero almost everywhere for step functions. This causes the optimizer to immediately terminate at the initial guess without actually optimizing the ensemble weights. A differentiable surrogate metric like log-loss or a derivative-free optimizer should be used instead.
